property_summary: After withdrawAll is called, the contract balance is zero only when msg.sender is the owner
The owner can always call withdrawAll successfully without reverting.
After calling withdrawAll with the owner as sender, the balance of the original recipient stays the same as before the call.
After a successful withdrawAll call, the recipient address's balance is increased by the full contract balance at the start of the call.
The balance of the contract should decrease by the full balance after a successful withdrawAll call from the owner.
